You want to be alive for the next part of the story!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on wave Wave 13 ([[A Dark Tale]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cobalt Guard''', internally referred to as '''Guard Plush''', was a slow and tanky enemy that appeared in the first and third act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health with a high amount of defense to accompany it, though it was quite slow. ==Appearance== The '''Cobalt Guard''' was a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It was entirely made of plush fabric shown by the stitches that could be seen throughout its body. It wore a dark purple crusader helmet, chestplate with white horns, leggings, belt, boots knee-pads and shoulder-pads as well as black braces with dark purple spikes. A pair of small white eyes in an angry expression could be seen in the eyeholes of the helmet. The '''Cobalt Guard''' had a death animation where it would fall to its knees before falling forward. ==Strategy== *Multiple cheap towers, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Golden Soldier]] can kill it quite easily. **Stronger and more expensive towers, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] can also be used. *Defense dropping towers, like the [[Pyromancer]] can be quite useful at reducing its high defense. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can also be quite useful at dealing with the weaker enemies that spawn alongside the '''Cobalt Guard'''. ==Trivia== *The '''Cobalt Guard''' is a plushie meant to resemble the [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Cobalt Guard''' added. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **Now appears in [[The Great Finale]]. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Cobalt Guard''' removed. {{ADarkTale|[[Knight (Lunar Overture)|Knight]]|Wave 12|Cobalt Guard|Wave 13|[[Executioner (Lunar Overture)|Executioner]]|Wave 16}} {{TheGreatFinale|[[Actor2 (Lunar Overture)|Actor2]]|Wave 5|Cobalt Guard|Wave 6|[[Voodoo Doll (Lunar Overture)|Voodoo Doll]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Cobalt Guard}}
